data.name: Darkness Bomb*
data.description: When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it suppress light sources on the target. This extinguishes nonmagical light sources carried by the target and dispels magical light sources for %1 rounds as deeper darkness.|AlchemistDiscoveryLVL
